about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a web developer with three years of experience building responsive, optimized applications. I mainly work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern frameworks like React, Vue and their meta-frameworks, Next and Nuxt.
about.p2: I care about continuous improvement in code and process: I integrate REST APIs cleanly, instrument GA4 analytics to understand real user behavior, and collaborate under agile methodologies focused on continuous delivery.
about.p3: I'm currently pursuing a Master's in Computer Science at UAM-Azcapotzalco, combining professional practice with a deeper theoretical foundation.
